about.title: About us
body: T&C Cosmetics brings skincare and cosmetics made in Vietnam directly to customers in Myanmar.
Every product is imported by us, stored at our warehouse in Yangon and checked for its expiry date before it is shipped.
Questions about a product? Contact us on Viber or Messenger — we are happy to help you choose.

shipping.title: Shipping
body: We deliver within Myanmar through our courier partner. The shipping fee is not included in your order total — you pay it directly to the courier when your parcel arrives.
After your order is confirmed we pack it and hand it to the courier. You can follow its status on the Track order page with your order code and phone number.

payment.title: Payment
body: Cash on delivery (COD): pay the courier when you receive the parcel. We call you first to confirm the order.
Bank transfer: after ordering, transfer the total and upload a photo of the receipt on your order page. We ship once the payment has been checked.
Unpaid bank-transfer orders are held for a limited time and then cancelled automatically.

returns.title: Returns
body: If a product arrives damaged, is wrong or is close to its expiry date, contact us within a few days of receiving it with your order code and photos.
Returned items are inspected first. When the return is accepted we refund the amount for the returned items or send a replacement.
For hygiene reasons, opened products cannot be returned unless they are faulty.

privacy.title: Privacy
body: We only collect the information needed to deliver your order: name, phone number and address.
Your information is used to process and deliver orders and to contact you about them. We do not sell it to anyone.
